stills.prompt: The same chamber as @room: same camera position, dome and oculus, columns, arched door standing ajar with warm amber light in the gap, steps, platform, the wooden chair with the coat over its back and the dark cup beside it. Rebuild all the stone in the material of @stone: polished black stone with fine natural veins of antique gold running through it, following the grain of the stone, not the joints. Set flush into the floor in the center of the beam, a large worn gold inlay of the emblem shown on @stone. The oculus is small and dim with no sky; one narrow shaft of warm gold light falls through dust onto the emblem. Everything outside the beam and the door gap is near-black. No daylight, no white or blue light, no grey stone, no people, no bowls on the floor, no lettering. Restrained, photorealistic, natural film grain.
